## Reproduction / Reproducción

Git commit, OS, Python version, Codex surface, exact command or prompt, and minimal fictional input.

## Expected and observed / Esperado y observado

Describe the expected result and include sanitized output. For image work, include the format and whether Pillow was installed.

For vulnerabilities use the procedure in SECURITY.md. Please omit secrets and personal data.
